name: MobSF - Mobile Security Framework
description: MobSF (Mobile Security Framework) is an automated pen-testing platform for Android/iOS/Windows apps. Upload an APK/IPA for static analysis (manifest, permissions, secrets, insecure APIs, certificate issues) and optional dynamic analysis via an instrumented device, plus a REST API for CI. A fast first-pass triage of a mobile app's security posture.
notes:
=== RUN (Docker - easiest) ===
  docker run -it -p 8000:8000 opensecurity/mobile-security-framework-mobsf
  # browse http://localhost:8000 ; upload APK/IPA

=== LOCAL INSTALL ===
  git clone https://github.com/MobSF/Mobile-Security-Framework-MobSF
  ./setup.sh ; ./run.sh

=== STATIC ANALYSIS OUTPUT ===
  - Manifest: exported components, debuggable, backup, permissions
  - Hardcoded secrets / API keys / URLs
  - Insecure crypto, cleartext traffic, weak TLS, pinning status
  - CVSS-style security score + PDF report

=== DYNAMIC ANALYSIS ===
  # connect a rooted AVD / corellium; runs the app, captures traffic + runtime API misuse

=== REST API (CI) ===
  curl -F 'file=@app.apk' http://localhost:8000/api/v1/upload -H 'Authorization:<api_key>'
  # then /api/v1/scan and /api/v1/report_json

=== ALTERNATIVES ===
  jadx + apktool (manual static)
  frida/objection (manual dynamic)
  QARK, AndroBugs

recommended.note: jadx to dig into code MobSF flags.

defense.why_it_works: MobSF automates the same static/dynamic analysis an attacker does manually, systematically surfacing manifest misconfigurations, embedded secrets, and insecure API usage in a distributed app.
defense.prerequisites: A copy of the app (APK/IPA); a rooted device/emulator for dynamic analysis.
defense.impact: Rapid, comprehensive inventory of a mobile app's weaknesses (secrets, exported components, weak crypto, pinning gaps).
defense.detection: Not applicable to the backend from static analysis; dynamic runs look like normal app usage.
defense.prevention: Shift-left: run MobSF (or equivalent SAST) in CI and fix findings before release; remove secrets, mark components non-exported, disable debuggable/backup, enforce TLS+pinning, and keep security logic server-side; attestation to detect tampered clients.
